'''Guzald''' was an old [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After being freed by the [[Kadri'Ra]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Saadoon-Kauldi]], Guzald willingly served Kauldi as his personal translator.

==Biography==
Guzald was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who had been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ordered to work in a [[Garbage scow/Legends|garbage scow]], along with hundreds of other slaves. At some point, due to his slavery, Guzald was forced to learn the hard [[Kadri'Ra language|language of the Kadri'Ra species]], as well as many other languages. Having grow older than many, the common vigour and fire of young Devaronians had faded in him.

Eventually, Guzald and the other slaves were [[Rescue at the Imperial garbage scow|liberated]] by [[Saadoon-Kauldi]], a [[Kadri'Ra]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and former slave himself who had began a [[Saadoon-Kauldi's anti-slaver campaign|crusade against slavery]]. Many of the prisoners that Saadoon-Kauldi released swore loyalty to Saadoon-Kauldi, and Guzald was one of those.

Considering Saadoon-Kauldi the closest thing to his king, Guzald remained to his side. Although Guzald had a family at that point, all of them were Imperial slaves and as such he had no contact with them.

By chance, Saadoon-Kauldi felt that he should refuse to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], as a protest against the Empire. Guzald had a good chance to become his personal translator, a duty he performed proudly and loyally.
